label: fine101_path
scope: Same-input C4z little-group matrices and finite-k numerical phase counts; no external global-gluing test or topological claim.

convention.matrix_orientation: IrRep row-wavefunction matrix transposed to source-column -> target-column coefficients

comparison_semantics.IrRep: Coordinate map G^-1 B from right_inverse(WF); unitary=False does not remove Gram inverse.
comparison_semantics.independent_raw: Overlap B=Phi^dagger T Phi; same-coordinate comparison uses solve(G,B), with G=Phi^dagger Phi.
comparison_semantics.energy: Convert both documented Hartree-to-eV constants to the independent checker constant; no fitted offset.
